campaign_name: PR-EG-R6-R2-R2 — Semantic Operation Coherence and Multi-Role Propositions
purpose: Repair and qualify host-validated semantic operations while preserving disclosure and delivery authority.
executive_summary: C — SEMANTIC OPERATIONS BELOW ACCEPTANCE. Added named propositions, witnessed bounded role transformations, explicit malformed-plan handling and preserved host authority. 68/68 new controlled cases pass. Regression 485 passed / 19 failed: five inherited, fourteen explained status/target-contract expectation changes. Fresh primary 150 turns / 10 conversations; matched baseline 45 turns; predecessor supplements 89 turns. Explicit local classification 130/150, dependent binding 25/74, false clarification 16/150; optimistic correction/followup success bounds 5/23 and 20/51. Automated grading overcredits failures and is not reliable acceptance evidence; matched relevance and sufficiency improvement remain unverified. Observed integrity checks and separate-process save/load pass within their documented scope. Keep the existing feature gate default off.
self_contained_review_test: Structural package verification: ZIP CRC, manifest/source hashes, 43-artifact presence, UTF-8 summary/manifest agreement, excluded state/credentials, source/holdout freezes. All pass. This is not independent human review.

testing.broader: 485 passed / 19 failed; 5 inherited, 14 explained changed-contract expectations.
testing.runtime_validation: 150 primary turns / 10 conversations; 45 matched baseline turns; 89 predecessor supplement turns.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Real provider, production HTTP. Controlled tests, pilots and automated grading reported separately.

campaign_specific: Provider classification, target choice and source-role interpretation remain fallible. Current-evidence spans do not independently prove unrestricted semantic entailment. Relationship-specific requested-role names can complicate relationship replacement and source-role alignment. Existing scope prefilter can miss unfamiliar bare corrections. Named-role ontology alignment across independent source interpretations can fail. Historical speech clarification uses bounded question context but does not add a new verified-history retrieval path. Multiple direct sources can still trigger generic clarification. Only finite state projections are measured. New holdouts are internally authored; automated grading shares the configured model and can itself err. Fourteen existing assertions now disagree with deliberate noncritical contract changes. The stricter historical-ID rejection is a design choice, not mandated by the no-legacy-topic-override invariant; an explicitly traced host recovery deserves external review. Keep gate off.

decisions_requiring_human_review: External review of below-acceptance behavior and fourteen explained contract-expectation failures.
does_not_prove: A/B qualification, independent human grading, externally authored holdouts, unrestricted state/disclosure integrity, or full-suite health.
recommended_next_step: Stop after PR-EG-R6-R2-R2. Await external review of failed transcripts, source-contract coherence and explained regression identities. Do not begin PR-EH or tune against the now-exposed holdouts.
